title: Power Series Solutions & Method of Frobenius

sections.heading: Power Series Solutions & Method of Frobenius Practice Exercises

questions.q: For \( (x^{2} - x)y''+y'-y=0 \), the point \( x=0 \) is:
choices: a point where no solution exists
a point where every solution vanishes
questions.answer: Dividing by \( x^{2} - x \) gives \( y''+P(x)y'+Q(x)y=0 \). The leading coefficient vanishes at \( x=0 \), so \( P,Q \) are not analytic there: it is a singular point.

questions.q: Near \( x_0=0 \), the power series solutions of \( (x + 4)y''+xy'+y=0 \) are guaranteed to converge at least for \( |x-x_0|<R \) with \( R= \)
questions.answer: The singular points are the zeros of \( x + 4 \): \( -4 \) (complex ones count). The nearest is at distance \( 4 \) from \( 0 \).
